name: onepagelove.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and model-training crawlers are blocked by choice. But 421 form controls have no label.
lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
summary: onepagelove.com scores 81 out of 100 (B). 4 checks fail now, 14 are at risk, and 35 pass. Fix first: 421 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 421 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /about, /articles, /inspiration, /templates and 88 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 94 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 1 AI answer or search crawler is blocked
fix.evidence: Amazonbot (Alexa answers) by Disallow: /. These bots fetch pages to cite them in answers. Blocked means the site is not quoted there.
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 94 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /, /about, /letters, for example .header-info > .opl-newsletter[data-opl-newsletter=""] > .opl-newsletter__form[method="post"][data-opl-newsletter-form=" and .site-footer__col--signup >…
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: X-Content-Type-Options is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers may guess a file's type and run it as script. Missing on all 94 pages analyzed.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
Model-training crawlers are blocked by choice
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 488 ms
Every page has a meta description
